description: Update an existing monitor's configuration including content checking mode. Only provided fields are changed.

checkInterval.description: Heartbeat monitors only: expected seconds between pings (plan minimum to 604800). Ignored for other types

failureThreshold.description: Number of regions that must fail before alerting

gracePeriod.description: Heartbeat monitors only: extra seconds a ping may be late before the monitor is down

headers.description: Custom request headers as JSON string

keyword.description: Value depends on keywordMatchType: keyword text, regex pattern, number of days, or unused (Pro+)

maintenanceEnd.description: Maintenance window end as ISO datetime string

maintenanceStart.description: Maintenance window start as ISO datetime string

regions.description: Comma-separated region IDs for multi-region checks (Team plan+)

name: update_monitor
